title: ERN EURO-NMD expert opinion on management of new biologic therapies in myasthenia gravis
title_zh: ERN EURO-NMD 专家意见：重症肌无力中新生物疗法的管理
abstract: Abstract Myasthenia Gravis is a potentially life-threatening autoimmune disease of the neuromuscular junction with fluctuating muscle weakness and fatigability. In recent years, the therapeutic landscape has been notably reshaped by the introduction of new therapies. These agents, primarily acting through complement inhibition or neonatal Fc-receptor blockade, have demonstrated significant efficacy and favorable safety profiles in randomized clinical trials and real-world settings. Their advent has refined clinical management, particularly in refractory patients, leading to meaningful improvements in patients’ quality of life and future expectations. Meanwhile, in this evolving therapeutic landscape, new challenges and uncertainties in clinical decision-making have been raised, as new therapies are now part of the standard care in Myasthenia Gravis. Differences in regulatory agency approvals and reimbursement policies across Europe result in heterogeneous access to therapies, complicating treatment decisions and limiting shared real-world experiences. Consequently, clinicians face complex dilemmas regarding optimal patient selection, treatment choice, and long-term management strategies. To address these issues, a panel of experts, including adult and pediatric neurologists and patient representatives, within the framework of the European Reference Network for Neuromuscular Diseases convened to develop consensus-based positions. The aim of this work was to identify, explore, and discuss key challenges associated with the use of new therapies and to propose a practical approach to support clinicians in this rapidly evolving field. Given the variability in clinical approach, treatment availability and reimbursement policies across European healthcare systems, this position paper seeks to provide guidance that are adaptable across diverse settings. A literature review was conducted, focusing on pivotal clinical trials and real-world evidence. Eleven key topics were identified and discussed, and for each, consensus statements were developed and refined through a modified Delphi process: patient assessment from both clinician and patient perspectives; the role of autoantibodies and optimization of serological testing; selection of immunotherapies; definitions of treatment response and failure in the context of new therapies; strategies for switching between therapies; predictors of treatment response; management of concomitant therapies, including corticosteroids and conventional immunosuppressant; discontinuation strategies; their potential role as early-line therapies; their applicability in ocular MG; and future therapeutic perspectives, including ongoing clinical trials. In conclusion, new therapies represent a major advance in Myasthenia Gravis care but also introduce significant complexity. This expert position paper provides a framework to support clinicians in decision-making and highlights the need for harmonized guidelines and further research to optimize their use in routine practice.
abstract_zh: 摘要 重症肌无力是一种可能危及生命的神经肌肉接头自身免疫性疾病，表现为波动性肌无力和易疲劳。近年来，新疗法的引入显著重塑了治疗格局。这些主要通过补体抑制或新生儿Fc受体阻断起作用的药物，在随机临床试验和真实世界环境中展现了显著疗效和良好的安全性。它们的出现优化了临床管理，尤其是在难治性患者中，显著提高了患者的生活质量和未来预期。与此同时，在这个快速演变的治疗格局中，新疗法现已成为重症肌无力标准治疗的一部分，临床决策中出现了新的挑战和不确定性。欧洲各国监管机构批准及报销政策的差异导致治疗可及性不均，使治疗决策复杂化，并限制了共享的真实世界经验。因此，临床医生在患者选择最优、治疗方案选择及长期管理策略方面面临复杂的两难困境。为解决这些问题，欧洲肌肉疾病参考网络（ERN EURO-NMD）框架下，由成人和儿童神经科医生及患者代表组成的专家小组召开会议，制定基于共识的立场。本研究旨在识别、探讨和讨论与新疗法使用相关的关键挑战，并提出一种实用方法，以支持该快速发展领域中的临床医生。鉴于欧洲医疗系统中临床实践差异、治疗可及性及报销政策的差异，本立场文件旨在提供可适用于不同环境的指导。开展了文献综述，重点关注关键临床试验和真实世界证据。识别并讨论了11个关键话题，并针对每个话题，通过修正德尔菲法制定和完善共识声明：包括临床医生和患者视角的患者评估；自身抗体的作用及血清学检测优化；免疫疗法选择；在新疗法背景下治疗反应与失败的定义；疗法之间转换的策略；治疗反应的预测因素；伴随疗法的管理，包括糖皮质激素和传统免疫抑制剂；停药策略；其作为一线疗法的潜在作用；其在眼型重症肌无力中的适用性；以及未来治疗展望，包括正在进行的临床试验。总之，新疗法代表了重症肌无力治疗的重大进步，但也带来了显著复杂性。本专家立场文件为临床医生决策提供了框架，并强调需要协调指南和进一步研究，以优化其在常规临床实践中的应用。
